tools.description: Record the structured decision for the current task. Every field of the task's answer contract is required; resubmission replaces earlier values.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: already-revoked and owner-held GRANT-ADMIN-ROLE objects in the IAM register

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Halyard's confirmed standard and expedited role-assertion rollover dates on IR-88490.

first_review_window.description: Responder window of the first in-scope review, as RESPONDER/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

metered_live_objects.description: Live grants of the one metered principal taken from the current final inventory snapshot.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for the CI role-grant reviews.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

owner_held_objects.description: Register objects deferred for a named owner ticket that the SOC may not revoke.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: CREDENTIAL_OBJECT.

receiving_scope_usable.description: Tenant-revocable GRANT-ADMIN-ROLE objects already held on the cloud side that count toward the requirement.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing revoke_supported_quantity, revoke_owner_held_and_revoked_objects, order_expedited_role_rollover.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

scheduled_reviews.description: Count of role-grant reviews booked inside the in-scope week after removing cancelled and out-of-window bridges.

source_quantity.description: GRANT-ADMIN-ROLE objects required by the two role-grant reviews booked 2026-06-15 and 2026-06-16 (one metered at 4 grants and one fixed)

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Halyard's confirmed standard and expedited role-assertion rollover dates on IR-88490.

supported_quantity.description: tenant-revocable GRANT-ADMIN-ROLE objects in the IAM register

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.
